Name conflict: the local variable `run` in pack_test (used as `run,ppath=img.lookup(...)`) shadows the global `run` function. Let me rename the local variables.

Also the atlas test with seed 7 only took 0.268s — suspiciously fast for n=30000. Because for it<3 it picks from the choice list randomly; seed 7 may have picked small n. Fine.

Let me fix the pack_test naming.
